sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: The reproducibility problem in science
passage.text: Science advances by repetition: a result becomes knowledge when other laboratories obtain it too. In several fields, however, large replication projects have found that a substantial share of published findings cannot be reproduced. The causes are mundane rather than scandalous. Samples are small, analysis choices are flexible, and journals reward novelty over confirmation. A researcher who tries twenty statistical models and reports the one that worked is not lying, but the reported result is no longer an unbiased estimate. Reformers propose three remedies: register the analysis plan before collecting data, publish negative results, and fund replication as a normal part of research rather than as a curiosity.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: A researcher who tries twenty statistical models and reports the one that worked is not lying, but the reported result is no longer an unbiased estimate.

answer.text: 一位尝试二十种统计模型、只报告其中奏效那一种的研究者并没有撒谎，但其所报告的结果已不再是无偏估计。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：who 引导的定语从句较长，拆成「一位……的研究者」；the one that worked 译「其中奏效的那一种」；not lying 与 no longer 构成对比，译文要保留这层转折。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words on the following topic: many published scientific findings cannot be reproduced. Discuss the causes and propose how the research system should respond.

answer.text: The credibility of science rests on results that others can reproduce, yet large replication projects suggest that many published findings fail this test. The explanation is rarely fraud. Small samples, flexible analysis, and journals that reward novelty all push toward fragile results. Three reforms follow naturally. Researchers should register their analysis plan before collecting data, so that the reported model is not chosen after the fact. Journals should publish negative results, which currently disappear and force others to repeat the same dead ends. Funders should treat replication as ordinary research rather than as an admission of failure. None of these changes is dramatic, but together they restore the repetition on which science depends.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：把原因全部归为「学者造假」，与原文 mundane rather than scandalous 的定性冲突；或只列改革不解释原因。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞
